flyer.justification: The flyer adheres to all format instructions including the 6-word title limit, captures the core themes well, and uses appropriate placeholders.

instagram.justification: The post effectively follows the required structure with carousel cues, engaging visual hooks, short emoji-accented lines, and 11 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive summary perfectly executes all structural requirements under 400 words with thorough coverage of the talk's core takeaways.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter keeps the subject line under 50 characters, provides three clear bold subheaded sections, and maintains an engaging editorial voice.

blog.justification: A comprehensive long-form article covering all key points with numbered sections, comparison table, conclusion, and author bio.

linkedin.justification: The post delivers strong insights and an engaging hook, but omits the required 3-5 hashtags.
